text:
Ivy: Heads-up: Crestline reserved pool goes live tonight 01:15 UTC. Config: 6xA100, soft quota 260k tpm, they expect burst promos to ~320k for 5-10m. Need canary plan, quick renewal note, and a rollback contact.
Ben: Copy. Proposed ramp: 10m shadow, 15m 35%, 25m 70%, then full for 2h. Recommend temp bump to 300k for 6h.
Harper: Runtime note: autoscaler default 68% util. For short promos set scale-out to 30s and scale-in to 4m. Enable KV pre-warm on top 6 endpoints and extend TTL to 10h.
Zoe: Crestline SRE asks for p99 <160ms and explicit failover to hosted-quant if Dedicated degrades. Also want an hourly cost snapshot during the window.
Ivy: Fallback rule: if p99 >220ms for 4m AND queue depth >180 for 2m -> shift 25% to hosted-quant-us and page #oncall. Manual approval before raising cut to 50%.
ScaleBot: Reminder: scheduled infra reboot at 03:00 UTC. Recommend moving to 04:30 to avoid overlap with their 6h window.
Ben: I'll reschedule reboots to 04:30. Patch moved.
Harper: Load plan: k6 shadow then vegeta for high RPS. Commands: `k6 run --vus 220 --duration 15m tests/crestline-shadow.js` and `vegeta attack -rate=12000 -duration=10m | vegeta report` for burst.
Zoe: We'll need a short enablement session tomorrow 10am PT for their infra team. Zoe to schedule.
Ivy: Adding renewal note: if sustained >75% quota for 14 days, CS will initiate expansion review and include cost projections.
ScaleBot: Canary runner scheduled: 01:20 UTC. Notifications -> #eng-runtime + #customer-success.
Ben: Shadow started. Quick log: "shadow 10m | rps ~5200 | p99 135ms | errors 0"
Harper: 35% stage: p99 148ms, GPU util 54%, KV hit 72%. Looks healthy.
Ben: 70% stage: small tail growth, p99 169ms, GPU util 74%, KV hit 69%. We'll watch shard-4.
Harper: Shard-4 queue spike at 01:46 UTC; autoscaler added +1 GPU and rebalanced. Rebalance succeeded.
Zoe: Crestline: "Seeing good numbers, proceed to full"
Ivy: Full stage started. Burst script scheduled at 02:05 UTC.
Ben: Burst log excerpt: "vegeta burst | rps ~12500 | p99 198ms | errors 0"
Harper: At burst peak queue rose but scale reacted +2 GPUs within 90s. p99 peaked at 205ms briefly then dropped to 160ms. No fallback needed.
ScaleBot: Fallback check at 02:07 UTC -> condition evaluated true for queue but resolved after scaling. No route cut executed.
Zoe: Customer asks for hourly cost snapshots; posted first snapshot to thread at 02:30 UTC.
Ivy: Post-run summary: soak 3h, peak scaled to 8 GPUs, avg p99 158ms, max GPU util 82%, KV hit avg 70%. No customer-visible errors.
Harper: Actions: file ticket RTE-1407 to investigate shard-4 hotkey distribution and consider improving default hot-shard hashing. Also update runbook with canary timings and k6/vegeta commands.
Ben: I'll create CS-5022 for renewal follow-up and cost deck.
Zoe: Scheduling enablement invite and adding Crestline contacts.
Ivy: Thanks team  great coordination. Closing after tickets created."
